tasks.title: Stuck-key watcher: alert and auto-release fake modifier keys
tasks.description: Background watcher in the X session polls per-device key state every 1s. A modifier held >=2s on the Virtual core XTEST keyboard (fake keys from xdotool/pynput) is released with xdotool keyup and a desktop notification says so; a Super/Ctrl/Shift held >=20s on a physical keyboard triggers a warning only. Log every event to ~/.local/state/stuck-keys.log. Autostart with the Cinnamon session. Root cause context: ledger note 01M677X3K38V8YW3TS2JQGPMHK.

tasks.title: Stop the voice typer leaving modifier keys stuck and cutting off push-to-talk
tasks.description: Remove every xdotool --clearmodifiers (it releases held modifiers then re-presses them on the XTEST device, leaving Super/Alt stuck and ending an Alt push-to-talk mid-hold). Before any key injection, wait until no modifier is physically held. Log which source toggles dictation. Regression tests incl. a real-X test that a held Alt never sees a fake release. Approved by Ryan 2026-10-30; ledger 01M677X3K38V8YW3TS2JQGPMHK.
